compare.title: Scenario Comparison
compare.description: Compare cached encounter reports and separate durable changes from sampling noise.
compare.emptyBody: Run and cache at least two scenarios before opening a comparison.
compare.sameScenario: Choose two different scenarios for a meaningful comparison.
compare.staleTitle: One or more reports are stale.
compare.staleBody: The scenario configuration changed after its report was generated. Re-run it before trusting the comparison.
compare.lowNBody: At least one report has wide confidence intervals. Treat all deltas as inconclusive until more fights are run.
compare.continuousMethod: Continuous rows use approximate 95% mean confidence intervals. CI overlap is a rough hint; a formal t-test or Mann-Whitney test remains a 6c v1.1 extension.
compare.rostersDiffer: Rosters differ by side or identity. Per-combatant deltas are hidden; side-level metrics remain comparable.
